target: Resume-first landing and paired tailor workspace

references: https://www.resumatic.ai — inspected 2026-10-07: resume-first proof, clear action and spacious hierarchy; do not copy branding or outcome claims

probes.thesis: A light, approachable resume studio where the document leads and the evidence sits alongside.
probes.layout: Split landing hero with paper foreground; compact app navigation and a document/review pane.
probes.typography: Shared Arial/system sans for controls and hierarchy; Georgia only inside the actual resume specimen.

probes.thesis: An editorial career folio with a personal, slower reading rhythm.
probes.layout: Centered title over a wide document-and-margin composition; horizontal app navigation.
probes.typography: Georgia editorial headlines, quiet sans utility text and readable resume specimen.

probes.thesis: A dark technical patch workbench with facts and redlines as the defining signature.
probes.layout: Horizontal headline/action band over a wide paper-and-proof workbench; dense app review sidebar.
probes.typography: Compact sans hierarchy, strong evidence figures and paper typography.

customReplacement.reason: Existing components already own navigation, imports, job entry, review and export; adapt their presentation.

contract.purpose: RolePatch helps job seekers prepare a resume for a specific role by matching the job description to supplied experience and showing a reviewable patch.
contract.canonicalPurpose: RolePatch tailors a resume and supporting application material to a specific job while keeping claims grounded in supplied evidence.
contract.audience: Job seekers with an existing resume and a specific role to apply for.
contract.job: Understand the resume-tailoring promise, enter the workspace, bring a base resume and job, review and export the revised draft.
contract.thesis: Resume Studio: light, spacious and document-led; show the actual resume and its supported patch before secondary campaign features.
contract.system: Typography: Arial/system sans throughout landing and app; Georgia only for resume specimens. Color: cool-white background #f8fafc, navy text #1b2940, cobalt action #345cf0, slate secondary #5b687c, pale-blue stage #e8eef9, green supported evidence and readable red errors. Spacing: 8px rhythm, 24/48px gutters. Layout: 1180px content measure, split document hero, compact navigation and paired working panes. Geometry: 8px controls, 16px document stage, fine borders and restrained paper shadows. Reduced-motion respected.
contract.signature: A white resume sheet with source-preserved facts highlighted, accompanied by a patch explanation that links the wording to the role and original evidence.
contract.risk: The restrained composition is quieter than Resumatic; the document and concrete change explanation must provide visual interest rather than decorative effects.
contract.qualityBar: Meet the owner’s Resumatic reference through clear hierarchy, generous space, a legible resume artifact, and a simple first-use path. Landing and app must feel continuous. Avoid the incumbent grid-paper/brutalist styling, marketing-as-audit prose, fake ATS/interview numbers, ambiguous controls, low-contrast text and campaign-first onboarding.

designSystem.observation: Both captures share navy Arial utility type, cobalt action, cool-white surfaces and white serif paper; app density serves its working task.

identity.observation: Same RolePatch arrow and name, resume artifact and reviewed patch vocabulary; footer colors aligned while shared structure is preserved.

vocabulary.observation: Resume, job, draft, changes, review and export agree. Keyword badge explains its heuristic after click.

productTruth.observation: Illustrative landing proof, browser-local guest data and review-before-use. No invented hiring metric, public MCP deployment or successful local AI generation is claimed.

handoff.observation: Built Astro CTA reaches /dashboard on localhost:4340, restores synthetic guest resume/job, opens source preview beside pasted job, and survives reload. Mocked generation tests pass; configured live AI remains a release gate.

checkpoints.findingsReview: Landing flags uppercase labels, numbered method steps and tight headline spacing. Uppercase resume headings and a three-step resume workflow are intentional; keep readable tracking in production. App had no triggered patterns. Fixed headline overflow by shortening the title to Your story. A sharper fit.; tightened document/review spacing and corrected brand layout after rendered review.

Cream background, tight editorial headline spacing, uppercase resume headings and numbered method labels are deliberate. Scan flagged low contrast on landing secondary text: retain as a correction before any Folio implementation; not the selected direction. The vertically stacked editorial composition replaces the earlier split probe.

Dark-only theme, uppercase labels, numbered steps and tight tracking are deliberate technical-system choices. No gradient, card-grid or generic badge wall; subject-native proof occupies the workbench. Dark-only is a tradeoff, not the selected direction.

Landing 8: uppercase resume labels, numbered method and native FAQ are intentional. Empty guest dashboard 14: native secondary cards/icon groups and discovery sparkle; moved job entry above discovery, corrected paper padding, heavy borders, mobile overlap and unclear labels after direct rendered review.

Same pin and empty-dashboard state: landing 8, dashboard 14. Uppercase resume labels, three-step process and FAQ retained. Secondary dashboard cards, icon groups and discovery sparkle remain functional native UI. Final paired renders independently reviewed; numeric fingerprints do not establish generated quality or owner acceptance.

hierarchy.observation: Document-led split hero and resume-first workspace; discovery and campaigns sit below resume/job entry. Secondary preparation remains available.

typography.observation: Shared Arial interface and serif resume; screen-only paper margins corrected flush-edge text; bounded small specimen captions remain.

composition.observation: Spacious split landing, real resume paper and explanation pane; mobile context now expands separately without overlapping panes. Shared footer remains lengthy.

identity.observation: Arrow mark, cobalt action, light surfaces and resume/patch signature match selected Studio on both rendered surfaces.

interaction.observation: CTA, guest creation/save/reload, pasted job, keyword explanation, keyboard mobile menu and job disclosure inspected. AI error is visible and source preserved; generated preview/diff tests use mocked AI.

responsive.observation: 390/768/1440 paired captures. DOM width checks show no document overflow; mobile keeps generation above source preview and expands preparation on demand.

projectCheck.command: pnpm cf:build; pnpm typecheck; pnpm docs:check; pnpm test src/__tests__/resume-assistant.test.ts src/__tests__/resume-mcp-route.test.ts src/__tests__/resume-extraction.test.ts src/__tests__/token-balance-consistency.test.tsx src/__tests__/new-job-button.test.tsx

findings: Uppercase document labels, method numbering and FAQ retained intentionally.
Native secondary dashboard card groups and discovery sparkle remain.

answers.product: AI resume tailoring: adapts an existing resume to a target job.
answers.audience: Job seekers with an existing resume and a role they want.
answers.value: Focused application with visible changes, claim review and a portable result.
answers.mechanism: Tailored artifact and source-fact annotations; before/after appears below the first viewport.
answers.proof: Clearly illustrative resume demonstrates intended output, not verified generation quality or customer outcomes.
answers.nextAction: Tailor my resume; start in browser, review, export and use.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner selected Studio. Local rendered design and scoped checks pass; final owner acceptance and hosted MCP/AI qualification remain separate. No deployment authorized.
